chatQuickQuestions: How do I use the system?
How do I interpret the result?
How do I download the report?
chatHowTo: To begin: select a model, upload a PNG, JPG, or WEBP histopathology image, and press “Analyze image”. You can then review the predicted class, confidence, and probabilities.
chatUploadHelp: In Diagnosis, press the upload area or drag an image into it. PNG, JPG, JPEG, and WEBP files up to 15 MB are supported.
chatModelHelp: The selector lets you choose the inference model. The “Recommended” label identifies the option suggested by the platform.
chatNoModel: No model is currently available. Check that the backend is connected and try again.
chatNoResult: There is no result yet. Go to Diagnosis, select a model, upload an image, and press “Analyze image”.
chatClassesHelp: The abbreviations represent nine tissue classes: ADI adipose, BACK background, DEB debris, LYM lymphoid, MUC mucosa, MUS muscle, NORM normal, STR stroma, and TUM tumor/adenocarcinoma.
chatReportHelp: After completing an analysis, press “Download PDF report” in the results panel. The report summarizes the model prediction.
chatAnalysisHelp: Analysis displays legacy data such as the confusion matrix, ROC/AUC curve, MCC, and statistical tests. These assess overall model performance; they do not confirm an individual case.
chatDataHelp: Training presents the available learning-process charts. Dataset summarizes the source, number of images, classes, and related links.
chatMedicalLimit: This platform is an academic support tool and does not confirm or rule out cancer. Diagnosis and all clinical decisions must be made by healthcare professionals.
chatMedicalSafety: I can’t assess symptoms or emergencies. If you have significant bleeding, severe pain, or rapid worsening, seek urgent medical care. For other symptoms, consult a healthcare professional.
chatFallback: I can help with image uploads, model selection, results, classes, reports, and the Analysis, Training, and Dataset sections.
